chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Wheat and barley are to be exchanged equal for equal; neither of them is to exceed the other.

key_terms.الشَّعِيرُ: barley, the other commodity mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْآخَرِ: the other party or counterpart commodity in the exchange
key_terms.اَلْحِنْطَةُ: wheat, one of the two commodities mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.رَأْسٌ بِرَأْسٍ: equal for equal, with no excess on either side
key_terms.لَا يُزَادُ: no increase is to be made

ai.seo_question: When exchanging wheat for barley, must the amounts be equal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the exchange of wheat and barley, requiring equality in amount between the two. It relates to the prohibition of riba by preventing an increase of one side over the other in such an exchange.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4013 - Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Wheat and barley should be exchanged one for one, and neither of them should exceed the other."
